notes: The two misses (E9 `"\\n\\t"`→`dvd`, E10 `"\\t\\r"`→`ddz`) both show a `t` immediately after a backslash being dropped while the backslash itself still shifts normally; every other backslash sequence (`\n`, `\u`, `\x`, `\\`) shifts uniformly. I added that one rule and left the rest of the +8 mechanism intact.
